# Optional isolated producer: no Tuist app, secrets, deployment or default SDK exporter.
[protocol, endpoint, tenant, output] = System.argv()
true = protocol in ["http", "grpc"]
uri = URI.parse(endpoint)
true = uri.scheme == "http" and uri.host in ["127.0.0.1", "::1"] and uri.port > 0
true = tenant =~ ~r/\A[a-z0-9-]+\z/

for {app, version} <- [opentelemetry_api: "1.5.0", opentelemetry: "1.7.0", opentelemetry_exporter: "1.10.0"] do
  Application.load(app)
  true = to_string(Application.spec(app, :vsn)) == version
end

Application.load(:grpcbox)
true = to_string(Application.spec(:grpcbox, :vsn)) in ["0.18.0", "0.17.1"]
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:opentelemetry_api)
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:inets)
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:ssl)
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:telemetry)
if protocol == "grpc", do: Application.ensure_all_started(:grpcbox)
Code.require_file("capture_exporter.exs", __DIR__)
Code.require_file("snapshot.exs", __DIR__)
Code.require_file("repo.exs", __DIR__)
Code.require_file("ids.exs", __DIR__)
Code.require_file("fixture_plug.exs", __DIR__)
Code.require_file("router.exs", __DIR__)
Code.require_file("completion_processor.exs", __DIR__)

resource =
  :otel_resource.create(
    %{
      "service.name" => "fixture-registry",
      "service.namespace" => "fixture",
      "deployment.environment" => "local",
      "deployment.environment.name" => "local",
      "fixture.tenant" => tenant,
      "fixture.bool" => true
    },
    "https://example.test/resource/1.0"
  )

exporter = %{
  endpoints: [endpoint],
  protocol: if(protocol == "grpc", do: :grpc, else: :http_protobuf),
  compression: :gzip,
  headers: [{"authorization", "Bearer token-#{tenant}"}, {"x-scope-orgid", tenant}]
}

config =
  :otel_configuration.merge_with_os(
    resource_detectors: [],
    create_application_tracers: false,
    id_generator: SDKFixtureIds,
    traces_exporter: {SDKCaptureExporter, %{output: output, owner: self(), exporter: exporter}},
    processors: [
      {:otel_batch_processor,
       %{resource: resource, scheduled_delay_ms: 60_000, exporting_timeout_ms: 15_000, max_queue_size: 64}},
      {SDKCompletionProcessor, %{owner: self()}}
    ],
    attribute_count_limit: 128,
    event_count_limit: 128,
    link_count_limit: 128,
    attribute_per_event_limit: 1,
    attribute_per_link_limit: 1
  )

:otel_span_limits.set(config)
{:ok, span_sup} = :otel_span_sup.start_link(config)
{:ok, provider} = :otel_tracer_server_sup.start_link(:global, resource, config)

for app <- [
      :phoenix,
      :bandit,
      :req,
      :finch,
      :opentelemetry_ecto,
      :opentelemetry_finch,
      :opentelemetry_phoenix,
      :opentelemetry_bandit,
      :opentelemetry_process_propagator
    ] do
  Application.load(app)
end

:opentelemetry.create_application_tracers(Application.loaded_applications())
propagator = :otel_propagator_text_map_composite.create([:trace_context, :baggage])
:opentelemetry.set_text_map_propagator(propagator)
tracer = :otel_tracer_provider.get_tracer(:global, :elixir_fixture, "1.0", "https://example.test/scope/1.0")
:ok = OpentelemetryEcto.setup(event_prefix: [:fixture, :repo])
:ok = OpentelemetryFinch.setup()
:ok = OpentelemetryBandit.setup()
:ok = OpentelemetryPhoenix.setup(adapter: :bandit, liveview: false)
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:bandit)
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:req)
{:ok, web} = Bandit.start_link(plug: SDKFixtureRouter, ip: {127, 0, 0, 1}, port: 0)
{:ok, {_, port}} = ThousandIsland.listener_info(web)

:telemetry.execute([:ecto, :repo, :init], %{}, %{
  repo: SDKFixtureRepo,
  opts: [telemetry_prefix: [:fixture, :repo], database: "fixture", hostname: "127.0.0.1", port: 5432]
})

:otel_tracer.with_span(tracer, "SDK client", %{kind: :client}, fn _ ->
  carrier = :otel_propagator_text_map.inject([]) ++ [{"tracestate", "vendor=opaque"}]
  response = Req.get!("http://127.0.0.1:#{port}/fixture", headers: carrier, retry: false)
  true = response.status == 200 and response.body == "ok"
end)

# The observer follows the batch processor's synchronous on_end insertion.
# Wait for all actual SDK completions, not response bytes or a timer/sleep.
for _ <- 1..5 do
  receive do
    :sdk_span_completed -> :ok
  after
    10_000 -> raise "five SDK span completions did not arrive"
  end
end

Supervisor.stop(web)
flush = :otel_tracer_provider.force_flush(:global)

result =
  receive do
    {:export_complete, count, result} -> %{count: count, result: inspect(result)}
  after
    20_000 -> raise "SDK export callback did not complete"
  end

{records, resource} = :erlang.binary_to_term(File.read!(output <> "-sdk-records.etf"))

:ok =
  File.write(
    output <> "-oracle.json",
    JSON.encode!(
      Map.merge(SDKSnapshot.document(records, resource), %{
        sdk: "erlang SDK1.7/API1.5/exporter1.10",
        elixir: System.version(),
        otp: to_string(:erlang.system_info(:otp_release)),
        versions:
          Map.new(
            [
              :grpcbox,
              :phoenix,
              :bandit,
              :req,
              :finch,
              :opentelemetry_phoenix,
              :opentelemetry_bandit,
              :opentelemetry_ecto,
              :opentelemetry_finch,
              :opentelemetry_process_propagator
            ],
            fn app -> {app, to_string(Application.spec(app, :vsn))} end
          ),
        protocol: protocol,
        flush: inspect(flush),
        export: result
      })
    )
  )

Supervisor.stop(provider)
Supervisor.stop(span_sup)
IO.puts("local SDK exported #{length(records)} spans: #{result.result}")
